scope: Six-turn server-paced motion harness; does not certify web application integration.
git_note: Working tree contains changes; this snapshot, not the parent commit, defines the baseline.
known_limitations: Cold-start first audio 14.29 seconds; one 0.817-second prefix-to-body gap in v70.
100-word/60-second text batching caused three initial analysis waits near 65 seconds; batch records confirm timeout flush after 60 seconds.
Two complete motions do not establish broad semantic quality or causal performance gains.
Pending prefix TTS and late body adoption branches covered by offline tests, not exercised in the two full runs.
Provider aliases and external services can change; bit-for-bit model output reproducibility is not guaranteed.
Environment package pins are an inventory, not a verified clean-machine installer; credentials, gateway, local model weights and caches remain external.
policy: Use this version as the reference for subsequent work. Changes require a new versioned snapshot; never overwrite this baseline. Future paid runs retain cumulative ledger and need a new run ID; freezing is not a new spending authorization.
